17:30 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Basketball
The Fighting Irish (4-0) take on the No. 1 Gators (4-0) at Michelob Ultra Arena. Both teams enter undefeated. Notre Dame comes in after beating South Carolina State 99-59 behind 36 points from Ethan Roberts, while Florida topped Merrimack 83-54.
